scope: All 86 slědovateljno/slědovatelno/sledovateljno inference markers and all 15 poslědovateljno occurrences in live v019 Latin sources.
choice: Replace 97 genuine inference/result markers with official type-1 zato/Zato, except the unique zato-že collision at base line 9955, which becomes tym samym. Preserve the three genuinely sequential poslědovateljno sites at base lines 2049, 2155, and 17206.
motivation: The inherited conclusion layer used the type-2 East-heavy follow-root adverb and included twelve semantically nonsequential poslědovateljno tokens. Official zato is a cross-family result marker already established throughout this edition. Context classification prevents damage to German sukzessive sites and to causal zato že.
alternatives_rejected: Retain slědovateljno after spelling repair: this preserves the dominant-language collapse and leaves twelve semantic sequence/inference errors.
Replace all poslědovateljno mechanically: three occurrences genuinely mean successively or sequentially.
Use tym samym globally: many existing occurrences mean identity ('the same'), and its bounded East/Southeast comparator support is weak.
Use teda/tedy or a full iz togo slěduje recast everywhere: these are either branch-weighted or unnecessarily invasive.
